name: World Cup 2026 Match Tracker
project: Create a worldcup match tracking system for 2026 , should show schedules, probabilities, calender view etc. create admin, user portal, multi user system.
description: Track World Cup 2026 matches, schedules, probabilities, and calendar views.

current_prd.elevator_pitch: A comprehensive platform for football enthusiasts to track the 2026 World Cup, offering real-time schedules, match probabilities, and an intuitive calendar view, fostering community engagement and an immersive fan experience.
current_prd.problem_statement: Football fans struggle to keep up with World Cup schedules, match details, and real-time updates across various time zones and platforms, leading to missed matches and fragmented information.
current_prd.solution: A centralized, multi-user web and mobile platform providing real-time World Cup 2026 match schedules, probability predictions, calendar integration, and administrative tools for seamless event tracking and fan engagement.

key_features.feature_description: Displays up-to-the-minute match schedules, kick-off times, and venue information, adaptable to user's local timezone.
Provides data-driven predictions for match outcomes, group stage advancements, and tournament winners.
Interactive calendar view allowing users to see all matches, filter by team or stage, and add matches to their personal calendars.
Secure user authentication, profile management, and personalized settings for notifications and favorite teams.
A dedicated backend interface for administrators to manage match data, user accounts, content updates, and system configurations.

steps: Application displays the main dashboard with upcoming matches.
Application displays a list of all World Cup 2026 matches.
User can filter matches by date, group, or team.
User selects a specific match to view detailed information (time, venue, teams, probabilities).
Admin logs into the Admin Portal.
Admin selects to 'Add New Match' or 'Edit Existing Match'.
Admin inputs/updates match details (teams, date, time, venue, scores, probabilities).
System updates the match data and reflects changes in the user portal.
User views a specific match detail page.
User taps on the 'Add to Calendar' button.
System prompts user to select their preferred calendar application (e.g., Google Calendar, Outlook).
Match details (date, time, teams) are automatically added to the user's personal calendar with a reminder.

current_prd.success_metrics: 90% user retention during the tournament, 500,000 active users, 80% positive user feedback, 99.9% uptime, 100,000 daily active users.
current_prd.competitors: FIFA Official App, ESPN, BBC Sport, OneFootball, LiveScore, Google Sports.
current_prd.vision: To become the go-to platform for major global sporting events, offering unparalleled real-time data, predictive analytics, and interactive fan experiences, fostering a global community of sports enthusiasts.

target_audience.name: Football Enthusiasts
target_audience.pain_points: Fragmented information sources, missing match kick-off times due to time zone differences, lack of centralized platform for all World Cup information.
target_audience.demographics: Ages 18-65, global, tech-savvy, owns smartphone/computer, interested in football/soccer.
target_audience.needs_and_goals: Stay updated with match schedules, track favorite teams, get real-time scores, access match probabilities, engage with other fans.

target_audience.name: Sports Media & Analysts
target_audience.pain_points: Difficulty in quickly aggregating reliable data, need for predictive analytics, time-consuming manual data collection.
target_audience.demographics: Sports journalists, content creators, fantasy league players, ages 22-55, global.
target_audience.needs_and_goals: Access accurate and timely match data, probability insights for reporting, track team performance, analyze trends.

phasing.rationale: This phase establishes the core functionality for users to register, view match schedules, and manage their profiles. It's a launch-able product that provides immediate value.
This phase enhances the user experience by providing an interactive way to view schedules and adds engaging prediction features, making the platform more comprehensive and interactive.

This phase focuses on the backend capabilities, allowing administrators to manage the system, content, and users effectively, ensuring the long-term operational readiness and scalability of the platform.

current_prd.design_principles:
1. User-Centric Design: Prioritize ease of use and intuitive navigation for all user types, from casual fans to administrators.
2. Real-time Information: Ensure schedules, scores, and probabilities are updated in real-time to provide the most current information.
3. Clarity and Readability: Present complex data (like probabilities and statistics) in an easily digestible and visually appealing format.
4. Accessibility: Design with accessibility in mind, ensuring the system is usable by individuals with diverse needs.
5. Consistency: Maintain a consistent visual language and interaction patterns across all portals (user and admin) for a cohesive experience.
6. Performance: Optimize for speed and responsiveness, especially when displaying live updates and large datasets.

current_prd.sitemap:
- Home (/) - Main landing page with overview of upcoming matches and key information.
- Schedule (/schedule) - View all World Cup match schedules.
  - Match Detail (/schedule/{match_id}) - Detailed information for a specific match.
- Probabilities (/probabilities) - View match probability predictions.
  - Match Probability Detail (/probabilities/{match_id}) - Detailed probability analysis for a specific match.
- Teams (/teams) - Browse participating teams.
  - Team Detail (/teams/{team_id}) - Detailed information for a specific team.
- User Portal (/user) - Personalized user dashboard and settings.
  - Dashboard (/user/dashboard) - User-specific overview.
  - Profile (/user/profile) - Manage user profile.
  - Settings (/user/settings) - User preferences and notifications.
- Admin Portal (/admin) - Administrator dashboard and management tools.
  - Admin Dashboard (/admin/dashboard) - Admin overview and quick actions.
  - Match Management (/admin/matches) - Add, edit, and delete match data.
  - User Management (/admin/users) - Manage user accounts and roles.
  - Content Management (/admin/content) - Manage general content and system configurations.
current_prd.navigation_design:
User Portal Navigation:
- **Global Navigation (Desktop):** A persistent left-hand sidebar or top navigation bar for primary sections: Home, Schedule, Probabilities, Teams.
- **Global Navigation (Mobile):** A bottom tab bar for quick access to primary sections: Home, Schedule, Probabilities, Teams.
- **User-Specific Navigation:** Within the 'User Portal' section, a sub-navigation (e.g., tabs or a dropdown menu) for Dashboard, Profile, and Settings.
- **Match Detail Navigation:** Breadcrumbs or a clear back button to navigate back from individual match detail pages.

Admin Portal Navigation:
- **Primary Navigation:** A persistent left-hand sidebar containing links to all main administrative sections: Admin Dashboard, Match Management, User Management, Content Management.
- **Contextual Navigation:** Within each management section (e.g., Match Management), sub-navigation or filters to switch between different views (e.g., 'All Matches', 'Upcoming', 'Completed', 'Add New Match').
- **Search and Filter:** Prominent search bars and filtering options across all list views (e.g., matches, users) to facilitate efficient data management.

user_stories.title: View Real-time Match Schedules

user_story.i_want: to see the real-time match schedule
user_story.so_that: I can plan my viewing experience and not miss any games

acceptance_criteria: The system displays a list of all upcoming World Cup 2026 matches.
Each match entry includes date, kick-off time, participating teams, and venue.
Match schedules are updated in real-time to reflect any changes.
Users can easily identify the current status of a match (e.g., upcoming, live, finished).

user_stories.title: Local Timezone Display for Match Schedules

user_story.i_want: the match times to be displayed in my local timezone
user_story.so_that: I don't have to manually convert times

acceptance_criteria: The system automatically detects the user's local timezone.
Match kick-off times are displayed in the user's local timezone by default.
Users have the option to manually select a different timezone for viewing schedules.
The selected timezone preference is saved for future sessions.

user_stories.title: Admin Management of Match Schedules

user_story.i_want: to update match schedules and venue information
user_story.so_that: users always have accurate and up-to-date information

acceptance_criteria: Administrators can access a dedicated interface to manage match data.
Admins can add new matches, including teams, date, time, and venue.
Admins can edit existing match details, such as kick-off times or venue changes.
Admins can mark matches as postponed or cancelled.
Changes made by administrators are reflected in the user portal instantly.

user_stories.title: User Account Registration

user_story.i_want: to easily register for an account

acceptance_criteria: Users can register for a new account using their email address and a password.
The registration process includes email verification.
Users can reset their password if forgotten.
The system provides clear feedback on registration success or failure.

user_stories.title: Secure User Login and Profile Management

user_story.i_want: to log in securely and manage my profile
user_story.so_that: my information is protected and up-to-date

acceptance_criteria: Users can log in to their account using their registered email and password.
The system provides secure authentication mechanisms (e.g., password hashing).
Users can view and edit their profile information (e.g., name, email).
Users can change their password after logging in.
The system clearly indicates when a user is logged in or out.

user_stories.title: Personalized User Settings and Notifications

user_story.i_want: to personalize my settings, such as favorite teams and notification preferences

acceptance_criteria: Users can select and save their favorite World Cup teams.
Users can enable or disable notifications for match events (e.g., kick-off, goals, full-time).
Users can choose their preferred notification channels (e.g., in-app, email).
Personalized settings are saved and applied across sessions.
The system provides a dedicated section in the user portal for managing these preferences.

user_stories.title: Interactive Match Calendar View

user_story.i_want: to view all matches in an interactive calendar
user_story.so_that: I can easily see the schedule at a glance

acceptance_criteria: The system provides a calendar interface displaying all World Cup 2026 matches.
Users can navigate through different dates and months in the calendar.
Each match entry in the calendar shows key details like teams and kick-off time.
Clicking on a match in the calendar provides more detailed information.
The calendar view is responsive and works well on various devices.

user_stories.title: Filter Matches in Calendar View

user_story.i_want: to filter the calendar view by team or stage
user_story.so_that: I can quickly find specific matches of interest

acceptance_criteria: Users can filter the calendar view by selecting specific teams.
Users can filter the calendar view by selecting different tournament stages (e.g., Group Stage, Round of 16, Quarter-finals).
The calendar view updates dynamically to show only the filtered matches.
Users can clear applied filters to view the full schedule again.
The filtering options are easily accessible within the calendar interface.

user_stories.title: Add Matches to Personal Calendar

user_story.i_want: to add matches to my personal calendar
user_story.so_that: I can integrate the World Cup schedule with my existing appointments

acceptance_criteria: Users can select a match from the calendar view to add to their personal calendar.
The system provides options to add to popular calendar applications (e.g., Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Apple Calendar).
The calendar event includes match details like teams, date, time, and venue.
Users receive a confirmation that the event has been added to their personal calendar.
The system handles timezone conversions correctly when adding to external calendars.

user_stories.title: View Match Outcome Predictions

user_story.i_want: to see data-driven predictions for match outcomes
user_story.so_that: I can gain insights and enhance my viewing experience

acceptance_criteria: The system displays win, lose, and draw probabilities for each match.
Predictions are presented clearly and are easy to understand.
The prediction data is updated regularly based on new information (e.g., team news, past performance).
Users can view a brief explanation of the factors influencing the predictions.
Predictions are available for all scheduled matches.

user_stories.title: View Group Stage and Tournament Winner Predictions

user_story.i_want: to see predictions for group stage advancements and tournament winners
user_story.so_that: I can follow the overall tournament progression

acceptance_criteria: The system provides predictions for which teams are likely to advance from each group.
The system offers predictions for potential tournament winners.
These predictions are updated as the tournament progresses.
Users can view the rationale or factors considered for these broader predictions.
The predictions are accessible from a dedicated section within the application.

user_stories.title: Monitor Prediction Model Accuracy

user_story.i_want: to monitor the accuracy of prediction models
user_story.so_that: we can continuously improve the prediction quality

acceptance_criteria: Administrators/analysts can access a dashboard showing the historical accuracy of match outcome predictions.
The dashboard displays metrics such as prediction hit rate, false positives, and false negatives.
The system allows for A/B testing of different prediction models.
Admins can review the performance of prediction models over time.
The system provides tools to retrain or adjust prediction models based on performance data.

user_stories.title: Secure Admin Portal Login

user_story.i_want: to securely log in to the admin portal

acceptance_criteria: Administrators can log in to a dedicated admin portal using their credentials.
The admin login process is secure and separate from the user portal login.
The system enforces role-based access control for different administrative functions.
Failed login attempts are logged for security monitoring.
Admins are automatically logged out after a period of inactivity.

user_stories.title: Admin User Account Management

user_story.so_that: I can ensure proper access and support users

acceptance_criteria: Administrators can view a list of all registered user accounts.
Admins can search for specific user accounts by email or username.
Admins can edit user profile information (e.g., name, email).
Admins can suspend or reactivate user accounts.
Admins can reset user passwords or force password changes.

user_stories.title: Admin Content Management

user_story.i_want: to manage content, such as news articles or team information
user_story.so_that: the platform remains engaging and informative

acceptance_criteria: Administrators can create, edit, and delete news articles related to the World Cup.
Admins can upload and manage media content (e.g., images, videos) for articles.
Admins can manage team information, including rosters, statistics, and historical data.
Content changes made by admins are immediately reflected in the user portal.
The content management interface is intuitive and easy to use.

user_stories.title: Admin System Configuration

user_story.so_that: I can control the overall behavior and functionality of the application

acceptance_criteria: Administrators can configure global system settings, such as notification preferences and data refresh intervals.
Admins can manage API integrations for external data sources (e.g., live scores, statistics).
Admins can set up and manage user roles and permissions.
Changes to system configurations require appropriate authorization.
The system provides an audit log of all configuration changes made by administrators.
